checklist.detail: NARloy-Z Copper Alloy (Cu-Ag-Zr): only 11% thermal margin (computed wall temp 719 K vs 800 K max). Thin margin. Basis: coupled throat wall balance: gas h_g ~12.6 kW/m2K incl. carbon-deposit credit, T_aw ~2854 K, coolant ~36 m/s (coolant-side wall ~701 K), 0.22 mm wall. Levers that lower it: faster coolant (Coolant velocity; SP-8087 caps liquids at ~61 m/s, at a jacket-dP cost), a thinner wall, a liner rated hotter or more conductive (e.g. GRCop-84), or more film cooling.

checklist.detail: Hottest wall station is in the convergent section (area ratio ~1.1, regen): wall ~743 K, 1.08x that section's material limit (warns below 1.15x, like the throat row). Levers: more chamber film (or a convergent film ring for the throat region), faster coolant, a thinner or more conductive liner, or extend active cooling.
